newsitem.title: MEXICO: PEMEX says to recover from explosion by June 1997.
newsitem.headline: PEMEX says to recover from explosion by June 1997.

text.p: State-owned oil company Pemex will recover the production levels it had at the Cactus natural gas plant before the recent devastating explosion by June 1997, official news agency Notimex reported company president Adrian Lajous Vargas as saying.
He told Notimex that the company will give a priority to rebuilding the natural gas plant in the state of Chiapas that was devastated by an explosion earlier this summer.
He said the overall cost of rebuilding after the explosion to the company will be $36 million and is covered by insurance.
He told the news agency that the plant could surpass pre-explosion production levels.
